source: 外研社选择性必修第一册 Unit 3 同主题完形(科技与运动/小游泳选手/老年体育俱乐部/篮球中的团队/马拉松的坚持/奥林匹克精神)。用词限 U3/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: Technology in Sport
passages.text: I love the way technology is changing modern sport. Using the latest (1)____, such as smart earphones, helps people get the best out of their training. In the past, (7)____ a great moment often meant it was gone forever. Today, however, we can save it and (8)____ it with friends online. passages.title: More Than One Player

passages.title: The Long Race
passages.text: Lin had always wanted to (1)____ in a full marathon. Everyone told her that forty-two kilometres was too (2)____ for a beginner, but she refused to (3)____ up.
